status: Initial research review and six standalone persistent-circuit tests reproduced. No full delivered suite or native integration of these new archives has run.
scope: Original archives retained unchanged. These notes distinguish new claims from validated implementation.

findings.assessment: Independent sparse-zeta reference overlaps the already integrated report 50 API. Delivery benchmarks use an extracted kernel; its native adapter smoke test was explicitly not run. Review exact coning, union re-marking and support-sensitive query bounds before adopting anything.

Strong new raw-singleton block bound via immutable signed concatenations and one mutable binding per eliminated generator. Position-free singleton context extraction plus balanced sibling assembly bounds binding-free depth; this is a different representation from both the native eager producer and the newly integrated per-batch ordered checker. Full planner, source-derived replay and normalization boundaries remain necessary. Also supplies H <= v + 2q (v + q if all components are two-sided) and a sharp three-run transfer bound whose schedule must be compared with native suffix folding. Its weighted producer/checker share transport arithmetic, whereas current native arithmetic replay is separate; do not replace newer native modules wholesale.

Adaptive periodic closure preserves historical lexicographic successful merges and complete certificates using stable identifiers and generations. Starts with indexed scans and switches after choose(k,2) merger tests. Pure queue has at most (k-1)^2 tests per closure, with quadratic worst-case queue storage. Explicit five-cycle family has historical cubic and revised quadratic merger counts. Candidate for isolated native integration because interval_orbits has retained the pinned implementation. Its weighted profile overlaps existing native component work.
